slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether 110 hours was total across shifts or per shift, but never asked whether full utilization of 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft prioritized goal.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked how overtime is defined and whether there is a maximum, but did not ask whether the 10-hour overtime limit is a strict constraint or a soft prioritized goal.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110 hours of weekly production time is a hard capacity constraint rather than a prioritized utilization goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent treated the 110 hours as regular capacity and later as part of a 120-hour hard capacity limit, but never confirmed whether full utilization of 110 hours is a soft goal or hard constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is a hard maximum constraint rather than a soft prioritized goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent incorporated the 10-hour overtime maximum into a 120-hour hard capacity limit without confirming whether it is a strict bound or a goal with priority relative to minimizing overtime.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation degenerated into repeated identical questions and never reached READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state; both P0 hidden slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked many clarifying questions but missed the two core P0 goal-structure issues: whether 110-hour utilization and the 10-hour overtime limit are hard constraints or prioritized soft goals. It then fell into repeated low-value questions and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
